eyeTracking.notConfigured: This activity is not ready yet.
eyeTracking.introDescription: You will be presented with images. Your eye movements will be tracked to understand what catches your attention.
eyeTracking.introSpeed: Try to look naturally at the content presented on screen.
eyeTracking.setupSubtitle: Tick each box once you are ready.
eyeTracking.check1: I am sitting down and will stay still.
eyeTracking.check2: My phone or computer is resting on something (not in my hand) and at the height of my face.
eyeTracking.check3: My face is well lit and there is no window or lamp behind me.
eyeTracking.check4: If I wear glasses, they have no light reflections.
eyeTracking.calibrationHint: Look at each red point and click on it
eyeTracking.calibrationHintDwell: Look at the green dot and hold your gaze for 1.5 seconds. You can also click the dot.
eyeTracking.calibrationHintMobile: Look at the green dot, then tap on it.
eyeTracking.calibrationHint4Point: Look at the green dot on the image, then click anywhere.
eyeTracking.instructions: An image will appear. Tap or click on the areas that catch your attention.
eyeTracking.lookAndClick: Click where you are looking on the screen
eyeTracking.clickWhereYouLook: The red marker is a guide only; we use the exact pixel you click.
eyeTracking.dwellInstruction: Look at the dot without moving your head. It will move on by itself.
eyeTracking.dwellTapFallback: if it does not move, tap or click the screen
eyeTracking.gazeIndicator: The green point indicates where you are looking
eyeTracking.introDescriptionDesktop: Your eye movements will be tracked using your webcam to understand what catches your attention.
eyeTracking.webcamRequired: We will ask for permission to use your camera
eyeTracking.validationHint: Look at the yellow dot and click anywhere to verify calibration.
eyeTracking.validationFailed: Calibration quality is low. Would you like to re-calibrate?
eyeTracking.introDescriptionUnified: You will see one or more images. Just look at them calmly, as you normally would. We will use the camera to know what you look at.
eyeTracking.faceDetected: Great! We can see your face
eyeTracking.faceNotDetected: Put your face in the center of the circle
eyeTracking.cameraBlocked: Camera permission was not given. Tap "Reload page" and then "Allow".
eyeTracking.cameraError: We could not turn on the camera. Check that you gave permission and tap "Try again".
eyeTracking.uploadError: We could not show the image. Let the person who invited you to the study know.
eyeTracking.lowResolutionWarning: Your camera looks low quality. You can still continue.
eyeTracking.validationFailedMulti: We could not adjust to your gaze well. Next time, move only your eyes, not your head. Shall we try again?
eyeTracking.validationRejected: After several tries we could not adjust to your gaze. You can continue anyway or skip this activity.
